items.title: Charles Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: getting into a taxi and going to Van Gelder’s studios... everybody would file into a couple of Checker cabs

ctx.x: No. No, Not at all. It just was, just happy to be included you know, and to do my best.
So on that day you described a rehearsal and then getting into a taxi and going to Van Gelder’s studios. So am I correct that that whole record was rehearsed and recorded in one day?

No. There was one day, maybe two, depending on the complexity of the songs. And then the next day everybody would file into a couple of Checker cabs. I guess if you had a Checker cab now it would be worth something on the antique car market you know.
